units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 29:7">Kel. XXIX, 7</cite> <he>מ׳ של סתתין</he> the stone-cutters’ mallet.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 13:17">Tosef. Sabb. XIII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 14:17">XIV</cite>), 17 <he>ולא יכה במ׳ ע״ג מפסלת וכ׳</he> he must not strike (on the Sabbath) with the mallet on the chisel (to open a casket of dates) … as one does on week days.—Pl. <he>מַקָּבוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Parah 3:11">Par. III, 11</cite> <he>מ׳ של אבן</he> stone mallets.
